name: kindle-attentionboard
description: High-contrast ambient attention board for jailbroken Kindle and desktop

scripts.build:helpers: mkdir -p bin /tmp/swift-module-cache && swiftc -module-cache-path /tmp/swift-module-cache -O src/native/media-helper.swift -o bin/media-helper && swiftc -module-cache-path /tmp/swift-module-cache -O src/native/tasks-helper.swift -o bin/tasks-helper
scripts.build: npm run build:helpers && tsc && npm run build:assets
